exodus.26.p1.b1.text: “You are to construct the tabernacle itself with ten curtains …

exodus.26.p1.b2.text: … of finely spun linen, each with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and cherubim skillfully worked into them.

exodus.26.p1.b3.text: Make fifty gold clasps as well, and join the curtains together with the clasps, so that the tabernacle will be a unit.

exodus.26.p2.b4.text: You are to make curtains of goat hair for the tent over the tabernacle—eleven curtains in all.

exodus.26.p2.b5.text: … Then fold the sixth curtain over double at the front of the tent.

exodus.26.p2.b6.text: Also make a covering for the tent out of ram skins dyed red, and over that a covering of fine leather.

exodus.26.p3.b7.text: You are to construct upright frames of acacia wood for the tabernacle. Each frame is to be ten cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.

exodus.26.p3.b8.text: with forty silver bases under the twenty frames …

exodus.26.p3.b9.text: The central crossbar in the middle of the frames shall extend from one end to the other.

exodus.26.p3.b10.text: So you are to set up the tabernacle according to the pattern shown you on the mountain.

exodus.26.p4.b11.text: Make a veil of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and finely spun linen, with cherubim skillfully worked into it.

exodus.26.p4.b12.text: … place the ark of the Testimony behind the veil. So the veil will separate the Holy Place from the Most Holy Place.

exodus.26.p4.b13.text: And place the table outside the veil on the north side of the tabernacle, and put the lampstand opposite the table, on the south side.

exodus.26.p4.b14.text: For the entrance to the tent, you are to make a curtain embroidered with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and finely spun linen.
